mo_ta_cong_viec:
YOUR NEW ROLE CODE LEAP
This role is for CODE LEAP's sister-company named AINAVIO.
 
AINAVIO is a startup providing an all-in-one cloud solution for the e-commerce industry to gather, enrich, and distribute product content at scale. We are using AI and workflow automation to help our clients improve their product information management. As a spinoff of a consulting company, we already have a large e-commerce company as our client and are financially backed to get our product to the next level.
 
We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer (Python) to join our team and help us develop further our deep learning models for image processing and classification.
YOUR EXCITING TASKS
Develop and maintain cloud-native backend services on AWS (e.g., ECS, SQS, SNS)
Design and build scalable backend services using Python on a production running product
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs following industry best practices
Write clean, maintainable code with proper testing coverage (unit and integration tests)
Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions
Implement basic observability practices including logging and monitoring
Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions
Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing
Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of production issues
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, especially in AI/LLM tooling
